🏢Business Requirements::
1. The master cost sheet view should be proper align and well design as per the client needs.
2. Better visibility of each details of master cost sheet.
3. The business requires a provision to define size-wise pricing in a single line item within the BOM, similar to how size-wise consumption is currently managed. Users should be able to enter or update the prices for each size under one BOM entry without the need to create multiple variants of the same item. This will simplify the process, ensure data consistency, and align with actual production and costing practices.
Single-line BOM entry for size-wise pricing – The system must support defining prices for multiple sizes within one BOM line item, avoiding the need to create separate item variants.
There is a gap in supporting Color-wise and Color + Size-wise entries, which are essential for more precise consumption calculations in multi-variant styles.
Currently the bellow mention setting is not Handel in the new BOM

Sewtech Use Case::
1. Sewtech requires flexibility to update BOM consumption in the following ways:
2. Color-wise
3. Size-wise
4. Color + Size-wise
5. Currently, the WFX BOM supports only Size-wise consumption. There is a gap in supporting Color-wise and Color + Size-wise entries, which are essential for more precise consumption calculations in multi-variant styles.
6. Currently the bellow mention setting is not Handel in the new BOM
Revised version of approved accepted CS will be routed for Exception approval only if there is reduction in Profit/markup%

When the mention setting(Revised version of approved accepted CS will be routed for Exception approval only if there is reduction in Profit/markup%) is enable system should send Bom for approval if the margin is less than the previous accepted BOM margin.

When the sub setting is enable(Enable Internal Costsheet for Exceptional Approval if profit / Markup% is less than initial version of internal Costsheet) system will compare the margin from initial level of the bom and then send for approval is it is less than initial level of the bom.

Now the requirement is user don’t want to make item variant then need in single line item, they can select multiple material color wise destination and these material color can also be mapped with single garment color.

Sewtech Use Case::
1. When the mention setting(Revised version of approved accepted CS will be routed for Exception approval only if there is reduction in Profit/markup%) is enable system should send Bom for approval if the margin is less than the previous accepted BOM margin.
2. When the sub setting is enable(Enable Internal Costsheet for Exceptional Approval if profit / Markup% is less than initial version of internal Costsheet) system will compare the margin from initial level of the bom and then send for approval is it is less than initial level of the bom.
3. Need to handle Multiple material color selected destination wise against 1 garment color.
4. Currently, if there is multiple material color against 1 garment or multiple material color wise destination, then user need to make the item variant then they can map multiple material color wise 1 garment color. And select desire destination.
5. Now the requirement is user don’t want to make item variant then need in single line item, they can select multiple material color wise destination and these material color can also be mapped with single garment color.
The system will provide a provision to update article prices based on garment size directly within the BOM, using a single-line entry approach.
When size-wise pricing is selected in the BOM, the Price Approval screen will allow size-wise updates.
If the Supplier Price List is enabled, the system will fetch size-wise prices automatically from the list during BOM entry.
A Max Price field will be added at the BOM line level for costing purposes, and its consumption equivalent will also be calculated based on UOM.

Section 2. 📘Scope:
1. The system will provide a provision to update article prices based on garment size directly within the BOM, using a single-line entry approach.
2. A hyperlink next to the Purchase Price field will be introduced in the BOM. Clicking this will open a popup screen displaying the mapping between garment size and article size, along with editable fields to enter size-wise prices.
3. The hyperlink functionality will be controlled through SLC (System Level Configuration) and can be enabled or disabled based on the client requirement.
4. The popup screen will include "Copy Below" and "Copy All" features for faster price entry across sizes.
5. Price Approval workflow will support size-wise pricing. When size-wise pricing is selected in the BOM, the Price Approval screen will allow size-wise updates.
6. If the Supplier Price List is enabled, the system will fetch size-wise prices automatically from the list during BOM entry.
7. In the Indent Details and RMPO modules, the system will display the size-wise price as maintained in the BOM.
8. The system will apply UOM conversion logic to convert Purchase Price to Consumption Price at the size level.
9. A Max Price field will be added at the BOM line level for costing purposes, and its consumption equivalent will also be calculated based on UOM.

Section 2. 📘Scope:
1. Provide a dropdown to select the consumption method: Color, Size, or Color + Size.
2. Based on the selection, the consumption entry screen should dynamically adapt:
3. Color-wise: Entry by garment and material color.
4. Size-wise: Entry by garment and material size.
5. Color + Size-wise: Entry by both garment color/size and material color/size in a matrix format.
6. Max consumption across entered values to be shown at the BOM line level.
7. Integrate with:
8. MRP
9. Production Order
10. Factory Production Order
11. FPPO Input Requirements
12. FPPO Local Routing Consumption
13. Consumption Marking (New & Old)
14. Extend functionality to Article Consumption Request with the same dropdown options and logic.
15. “Copy All” and “Copy Below” options for all input modes.
When this setting is active, the Destination field on the main BOM line will be disabled, to avoid conflicting data input.

Section 2. 📘Scope:
1. A new setting needs to be introduced under the BOM or Cost Sheet configuration, titled:
"Allow selection of multiple material colors against one style color."
2. When this setting is enabled:
3. The Color/Size-wise Consumption pop-up will allow multi-selection of material colors.
4. A Destination field will be available in the same pop-up.
5. Users will be able to define destinations color-wise directly within this screen.
6. By default, the Destination will be set to "All". However, users can override this by selecting a specific destination for each material color, if required.
7. When this setting is active, the Destination field on the main BOM line will be disabled, to avoid conflicting data input.
8. In the case where there is only one garment color, and the user opens the Color/Size-wise Consumption pop-up:
9. Initially, only one line (based on the garment color) will appear.
10. If the user maps multiple material colors (e.g., 3) to the same garment color, the system will automatically split the single line into multiple lines—each representing one material color—allowing destination selection per material color.
In case of Price approval if it is enabled then that also will be impacted

2. Same process could be use in the Size wise price update case also.

Section 3. 📌Assumptions:
1. Garment and material color and size mappings are already configured in the system.
2. UOM conversions and wastage calculations remain unchanged and are already defined.
3. The system will use max consumption from entered values for costing calculations.

If no destination is selected for any material color in the color-size pop-up, the system will assume the default value "All".

This transformation will occur only when the user initiates or modifies the color-size-wise mapping.

Section 3. 📌Assumptions:
1. If no destination is selected for any material color in the color-size pop-up, the system will assume the default value "All".
2. When multiple material colors are mapped to a single garment color, the system will dynamically split the row into multiple lines for detailed destination assignment. This transformation will occur only when the user initiates or modifies the color-size-wise mapping.

BOM Module Enhancement. Requirement 3:
1. A dropdown must be added in the New BOM screen to allow users to select the consumption type: Color-wise, Size-wise, or Color + Size-wise.
  – If Color is selected, the system will display color-wise details, and users will be able to enter consumption accordingly.
  – All calculation logic will follow the same process as currently implemented for size-wise consumption.
2. The system should display both garment color and material color, along with their dependency mapping.
3. If Size-wise consumption is selected:
  – The system will display size-related fields, allowing users to enter size-wise consumption values.
  – It will also show garment size and material size, including their dependencies.
4. If Color + Size is selected:
  – A tabular interface will be shown, allowing users to enter consumption values for each combination of color and size.
  – Both garment color/size and material color/size, along with their dependencies, will be presented.
5. In all cases, the maximum consumption value entered will be highlighted and displayed on the BOM line for cost calculation purposes.
6. The Article Consumption Request module should also support all three modes:
  – If Color-wise is selected in the BOM, the same should be editable in the Article Consumption Request.
  – If Size-wise is selected, the Article Consumption Request should allow size-wise entry.
  – If Color + Size-wise is selected, the same should be enabled for input in Article Consumption Request.
7. Same way if color is select from the drop down then details will show as per colors.
8. If Color + Size will be selected from the Drop Down. Details will show color + size wise.
9. In all types of consumption updates, the Indent module will display consumption data based on the selection made in the BOM:
10. If Color-wise consumption is selected, the Indent will show consumption values (including wastage) as per the garment color.
11. If Size-wise consumption is selected, the Indent will display consumption (including wastage) based on the garment size.
12. If Color + Size-wise consumption is selected, the Indent will reflect consumption (including wastage) according to the garment color and size combination.

chunks.title: BOM Module Enhancement. Requirement 2
chunks.heading: Section 4. 🛠️Solution › BOM Module Enhancement. Requirement 2
chunks.text:
• A hyperlink icon will be displayed next to the Purchase Price field in each BOM line.
• Clicking the hyperlink opens a popup screen showing:
• Garment size vs Article size mapping.
• Editable price fields per garment size.
• Two buttons:
• Copy Below: Copies entered price to all sizes below current row
• Copy All: Copies price across all size entries.
• A new Max Price field will be added in the BOM grid line, capturing the highest price among all sizes for costing.
• The Max Price should be displayed at the BOM line level for cost calculation purposes. Based on the UOM conversion, the corresponding Consumption Price should also be automatically calculated.
• In case of Price approval System should allow user to update the Price as per size wise.
• On Indent details screen and RMPO screen prices should show size wise as updated in the BOM.

chunks.title: BOM Module Enhancement. Requirement 3
chunks.heading: Section 4. 🛠️Solution › BOM Module Enhancement. Requirement 3
chunks.text:
• A dropdown must be added in the New BOM screen to allow users to select the consumption type: Color-wise, Size-wise, or Color + Size-wise.
  – If Color is selected, the system will display color-wise details, and users will be able to enter consumption accordingly.
  – All calculation logic will follow the same process as currently implemented for size-wise consumption.
• The system should display both garment color and material color, along with their dependency mapping.
• If Size-wise consumption is selected:
  – The system will display size-related fields, allowing users to enter size-wise consumption values.
  – It will also show garment size and material size, including their dependencies.
• If Color + Size is selected:
  – A tabular interface will be shown, allowing users to enter consumption values for each combination of color and size.
  – Both garment color/size and material color/size, along with their dependencies, will be presented.
• In all cases, the maximum consumption value entered will be highlighted and displayed on the BOM line for cost calculation purposes.
• The Article Consumption Request module should also support all three modes:
  – If Color-wise is selected in the BOM, the same should be editable in the Article Consumption Request.
  – If Size-wise is selected, the Article Consumption Request should allow size-wise entry.
chunks.locator: § Section 4. 🛠️Solution › BOM Module Enhancement. Requirement 3

chunks.title: BOM Module Enhancement. Requirement 3
chunks.heading: Section 4. 🛠️Solution › BOM Module Enhancement. Requirement 3
chunks.text:
– If Color + Size-wise is selected, the same should be enabled for input in Article Consumption Request.
• Same way if color is select from the drop down then details will show as per colors.
• If Color + Size will be selected from the Drop Down. Details will show color + size wise.
• In all types of consumption updates, the Indent module will display consumption data based on the selection made in the BOM:
• If Color-wise consumption is selected, the Indent will show consumption values (including wastage) as per the garment color.
• If Size-wise consumption is selected, the Indent will display consumption (including wastage) based on the garment size.
• If Color + Size-wise consumption is selected, the Indent will reflect consumption (including wastage) according to the garment color and size combination.
Acceptance Criteria:

chunks.heading: Section 4. 🛠️Solution › BOM Module Enhancement. Requirement 4
chunks.text:
• Need to handle Exception approver in New Bom Page.
As of now when our bellow mention setting is enable system send costsheet for exception approver in case of reduction of margin but as we are working on new bom for now where we don’t’ need to create costsheet this setting is not handle in the New Bom.
The working of exception approver will be as mention bellow:
• When the mention setting(Revised version of approved accepted CS will be routed for Exception approval only if there is reduction in Profit/markup%) is enable system should send Bom for approval if the margin is less then the previous accepted BOM margin.
• When the sub setting is enable(Enable Internal Costsheet for Exceptional Approval if profit / Markup% is less than initial version of internal Costsheet) system will compare the margin from initial level of the bom and then send for approval is it is less than initial level of the bom.
Acceptance Criteria:

chunks.title: BOM Module Enhancement. Requirement 5
chunks.heading: Section 4. 🛠️Solution › BOM Module Enhancement. Requirement 5
chunks.text:
• Need to handle destination wise material colour without entering variant line.
• In the hyper link where user will enter color wise or size wise consumption there need to add Destination field. And allow user to select multiple color against one garment color.
BOM line destination will be hide if this setting is enabled and all the destination work flow will happen from this new Destination selection.
• If user select multiple Garment color against 1 Material color then based on selection of no of materialnt color system will create multiple line showing Garment color as same and different material color.
Acceptance Criteria:
• A new setting needs to be introduced under the BOM or Cost Sheet configuration, titled:
"Allow selection of single Garment colors against Multiple color."
• When this setting is enabled:
• The Color/Size-wise Consumption pop-up will allow selection of Garment colors.
• A Destination field will be available in the same pop-up.
• Users will be able to define destinations color-wise directly within this screen.
• By default, the Destination will be set to "All". However, users can override this by selecting a specific destination for each material color, if required.
• When this setting is active, the Destination field on the main BOM line will be disabled, to avoid conflicting data input.
chunks.locator: § Section 4. 🛠️Solution › BOM Module Enhancement. Requirement 5

chunks.title: BOM Module Enhancement. Requirement 5
chunks.heading: Section 4. 🛠️Solution › BOM Module Enhancement. Requirement 5
chunks.text:
• In the case where there is only one Material color, and the user opens the Color/Size-wise Consumption pop-up:
• Initially, only one line (based on the garment color) will appear.
• If the user maps same Garment colors (e.g., 3) to the multiple Material color, the system will automatically split the single line into multiple lines—each representing one material color—allowing destination selection per material color.
🔄 Impacts on Other Areas:
